items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: He was playing in the same band with us when Howard had his brass band.

ctx.x: Did you ever know Louis Dumaine?

That's the thing I was trying to call. That's the guy made an offer to me to teach me music. He was crazy about my bass drum playing too. That's the name I was trying to call, Louis Dumaine. Yeah. Fine old man. Fine, fine guy. He was playing in the same band with us when Howard had his brass band.
I see. How long were you with Howard?
